format: TypeScript (TSX/React-like component syntax with Qwik framework)
description: This file defines the main component for the Notes application using the Qwik framework. It manages state signals, handles CRUD operations for notes, filters notes by category and search term, and renders the UI including sidebar, toolbar, notes list, and editor.

methods.name: uuid
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier using crypto or fallback to timestamp and random number.

methods.name: categoryCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of notes in a given category.

methods.name: selectNote
methods.description: Selects a note by ID and loads it into the editor.

methods.name: resetEditor
methods.description: Resets the editor fields to create a new note.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note and adds it to the notes list.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates the currently selected note with the editor content.
